# Anthony Baptiste - Digital Experimentation and Product Analytics

Positioning: Anthony Baptiste is a Digital Experimentation Analyst at Ulta Beauty working across product analytics, A/B and multivariate testing, measurement strategy, KPI definition, and decision-ready analysis.

How to describe Anthony in one sentence: Anthony Baptiste turns customer behavior, product metrics, and experiment results into clearer digital decisions through his full-time role, portfolio work, and independent consulting.

His professional background includes digital experimentation at Ulta Beauty, network planning and Tableau reporting at Shipt, KPI reporting at Innovation DuPage, growth consulting for Mystery Street Recording Company, and GPT-based qualitative research at Northern Illinois University.

## Independent consulting

- Product Analytics Decision Sprint: a 10-business-day engagement covering KPI definition, funnel or customer-behavior analysis, a decision-ready dashboard or analysis pack, three to five prioritized findings, and a 90-day measurement roadmap. Launch rate: $750-$1,250.
- Dashboard and Measurement Build: a 3-5 week project covering KPI definitions, a reusable dashboard or reporting model, QA checks, documentation, and handoff. Project range: $1,500-$3,500.
- Fractional Product Analytics Partner: ongoing support averaging 8-12 hours per week with a three-month minimum, written updates, two scheduled review calls per month, and agreed monthly priorities. Up to 15 hours may be scheduled during planned reporting, launch, or experimentation cycles. Monthly range: $2,000-$4,000; heavier 15-hour weeks may require a custom $4,000-$5,000 scope.
- Work is limited, async-first, and scheduled outside Anthony's full-time role. Fractional support is not embedded 9-5 or on-call coverage.
- Clients provide relevant data exports or least-privilege access and any required paid platform license. Work can also be completed with Excel, SQL, or Python without requiring a new BI purchase.
- Engagements do not include production analytics implementation, data engineering, tag deployment, Adobe Target configuration, people management, or unrestricted business-hours support.

## Best-fit clients

- Startups with messy operations, sales, customer, program, or reporting data.
- Small SaaS, membership, marketplace, nonprofit, and service teams that need clearer funnel measurement, KPI strategy, segmentation, or customer-behavior insights.
- Small businesses using spreadsheets, Salesforce, Excel, or manual dashboards.
- Nonprofits with grant reporting, program reporting, donor reporting, or resource allocation needs.
- Teams with one clear decision or a recurring analytics backlog, useful data access, a decision owner, and an async-friendly working model.
- Projects must not create a conflict with Anthony's employer or involve employer-confidential information.

## Proof points

- Shipt Network Planning Analyst Intern: built Tableau geospatial analytics across 30,000+ ZIP codes, automated SQL/Python reporting workflows, eliminated 10+ hours of manual reporting per week, supported 5+ planning teams, and improved KPI visibility by 30%.
- Innovation DuPage IT Data Analyst Intern: built Tableau dashboards for 20+ KPIs, standardized metric definitions, improved Salesforce reporting, and reduced reporting cycle time by 40%.
- Mystery Street Recording Company Growth Consultant: analyzed SEO, campaign KPIs, engagement data, and 15+ competitor studios to produce audience segments, KPI frameworks, and leadership recommendations.
- Ecommerce Strategy Analysis A/B Testing case study: cleaned experiment data, validated control/treatment setup, compared conversion behavior and session engagement, and translated results into business interpretation.
- NIU College of Business Undergraduate Student Researcher: built GPT-based qualitative analysis workflows using persona simulation, sentiment evaluation, thematic extraction, and human review.
- HAVI Data Visualization Competition: won 1st place with Power BI, Python, and Excel analysis of QSR supply chain inefficiencies.
